name: Article 4, § 3 – 96
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 3. In the case of plans, programmes or projects for which the obligation to carry out assessments of the effects on the environment may arise simultaneously from two or more of the Directives referred to in Article 1(1), Member States shall issue one single opinion on the scope and level of detail of the information to be included in the environmental assessment report.
